description: GW quasiparticle calculations for accurate band gaps and spectral functions
workflow: MULTI-STEP: 1) PBE SCF → 2) exact diag → 3) GW

step1_scf.description: DFT ground state with enough empty bands

NBANDS.rule: many more than default, typically 4-8x occupied bands

step2_exact_diag.description: Exact diagonalization to get all orbitals

ALGO.note: G0W0 for one-shot, GW0 for partially self-consistent

NBANDSGW.rule: number of QP energies to compute, typically around occupied bands + few empty

GW0.note: partial self-consistency in G, better than G0W0

kpoints.rule: Gamma-centered, typically coarser than DFT due to cost. 4x4x4 is common.
kpoints.note: Converge NBANDS, ENCUTGW, NOMEGA, and k-points independently

convergence_parameters: NBANDS: most critical, needs many empty bands
k-points: systematic but expensive to converge
